notes: All four assigned records have identical descriptions and locators. No mapping of IDs to different tests can be established independently; no mapping was inferred from input order. Both primary papers were located and titles verified. Original frozen supplied cache covers Study 4 rather than requested page 120, so the author-uploaded original was independently consulted. Page 120 includes Table 2 correlations and a 107-undergraduate recall extension without a unique target-test locator. Replication Study 1 reports final N = 82 after four disbelief exclusions, but that study-wide N was not silently assigned to an unspecified contrast. Authors explicitly describe Study 1 as replicating and extending the needs-based model; the success field records that broad narrative, not a test-specific verdict. Terminal unverified statistics: locator insufficient, not paper unavailable.
